standpoint claim

  • CURIE: gmeow:standpointClaim
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/standpointClaim
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/standpoint

The StandpointClaim observation that a StandpointTenure generates — the reified observation of the tenure's time-scoped fact. The tenure is the time-scoped situation; the claim is the observation of that fact. Functional: a tenure generates exactly one claim.

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:StandpointTenure -> gmeow:StandpointClaim; functional

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:standpointClaim from gmeow:StandpointTenure to gmeow:StandpointClaim when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:StandpointTenure, gmeow:StandpointClaim
